summary: Learn ISO 45003-based workplace risk assessment, controls, and action planning. Explore the five-day course and build practical OHS capability.
lede: Psychosocial risk management helps OHS, HR, safeguarding, and occupational-health professionals identify workplace hazards and plan controls. The training covers assessing workload, violence and harassment, burnout, and remote-work risks; using a risk matrix to build a hazard register; and planning controls, incident responses, and follow-up through reporting workflows.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for preventing, assessing, investigating, or overseeing psychosocial hazards in workplace settings. It is relevant to OHS, HR, safeguarding, occupational health, and employee relations functions.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of workplace OHS, HR, employee relations, safeguarding, or occupational health processes is recommended. No coding or specialist clinical qualification is required. Bring a laptop with access to spreadsheet software if you want to complete the digital tracking exercise electronically.
